title: Explaining Cross-Label Decision Structure in Multi-Output Tree Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2611.20996v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A multi-output tree ensemble predicts several binary labels through decision paths that it largely shares across those labels, yet the attribution methods commonly used to explain such models treat each output in isolation. We propose multi-sink Decision Predicate Graphs (ms-DPGs), which extend decision predicate graphs with one sink per label: each leaf contributes to the sink of every label its in-bag positive count for that label. On this representation we define Shared Predicate Flow (SPF), the share of a label's decision mass that passes through conditions active for both labels of a pair, and a contracted view of the graph in which label-specific lifts indicate whether a shared condition raises the probability of both labels or of one at the expense of the other. translated_title: 解释多输出树集成中的跨标签决策结构
translated_abstract: 多输出树集成通过决策路径预测多个二元标签，而这些路径在很大程度上被各标签所共享，然而常用于解释此类模型的归因方法往往将每个输出孤立地对待。我们提出了多汇点决策谓词图，它在决策谓词图的基础上为每个标签增设一个汇点：每个叶子节点将其在该标签上的袋内正样本计数贡献给该标签对应的汇点。在这一表示之上，我们定义了共享谓词流，即某个标签的决策质量中流经对该标签对双方均活跃的条件所占的比例，并给出图的收缩视图，其中标签特定的提升度能够表明某个共享条件是同时提升两个标签的概率，还是以牺牲其中一个标签为代价来提升另一个。受控实验表明，SPF 捕捉的是共享的决策条件，而不仅仅是特征层面的重叠。在九个多标签基准数据集上，原生的多输出森林……
tldr: 提出多汇点决策谓词图与共享谓词流，在统一表示中量化并解释多输出树集成里标签之间共享的决策条件，以及这些共享条件对标签概率是协同提升还是此消彼长。
en_tdlr: Proposes multi-sink Decision Predicate Graphs (ms-DPGs) and Shared Predicate Flow (SPF) to explain, within a unified representation, how multi-output tree ensembles share decision conditions across labels and whether those shared conditions jointly boost both labels or trade one off against the other.
